description: For one of the organization's verified websites: the few searches Website Growth Ops looked up in Google's results (picked from its own topics, within the plan's monthly allowance), each with the website's exact rank, the top results and their page types, People Also Ask questions, related searches and the result types shown, plus this month's lookups used and allowed. Public search results are context, never the source of a number in a finding. It changes nothing.
